# Local Operator UI

A modern, futuristic user interface for the [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) project. This UI allows you to chat with the AI assistant and track planned, executing, and completed actions.

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators
- **Planning & Execution View**: Tabbed interface to see planned, executing, and completed actions in real-time
- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

# Local Operator UI

A modern, futuristic user interface for the [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) project. This UI allows you to chat with the AI assistant and track planned, executing, and completed actions.

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators
- **Planning & Execution View**: Tabbed interface to see planned, executing, and completed actions in real-time
- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

A modern, futuristic user interface for the [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) project. This UI allows you to chat with the AI assistant and track planned, executing, and completed actions.

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators
- **Planning & Execution View**: Tabbed interface to see planned, executing, and completed actions in real-time
- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")

- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

## Acknowledgements

- [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) - The backend for this UI
- [Font Awesome](https://fontawesome.com/) - Icons used in the UI
- [highlight.js](https://highlightjs.org/) - Code syntax highlighting
# Local Operator UI

A modern, futuristic user interface for the [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) project. This UI allows you to chat with the AI assistant and track planned, executing, and completed actions.

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators
- **Planning & Execution View**: Tabbed interface to see planned, executing, and completed actions in real-time
- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

# On macOS

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows

```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

- [Font Awesome](https://fontawesome.com/) - Icons used in the UI
- [highlight.js](https://highlightjs.org/) - Code syntax highlighting

# Local Operator UI

A modern, futuristic user interface for the [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) project. This UI allows you to chat with the AI assistant and track planned, executing, and completed actions.

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators
- **Planning & Execution View**: Tabbed interface to see planned, executing, and completed actions in real-time
- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators
- **Planning & Execution View**: Tabbed interface to see planned, executing, and completed actions in real-time
- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")

- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

This project is licensed under the GPL 3.0 License - see the LICENSE file for details.

## Acknowledgements

- [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) - The backend for this UI
- [Font Awesome](https://fontawesome.com/) - Icons used in the UI
- [highlight.js](https://highlightjs.org/) - Code syntax highlighting
# Local Operator UI

A modern, futuristic user interface for the [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) project. This UI allows you to chat with the AI assistant and track planned, executing, and completed actions.

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators
- **Planning & Execution View**: Tabbed interface to see planned, executing, and completed actions in real-time
- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:

# Using Node.js

```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

- [highlight.js](https://highlightjs.org/) - Code syntax highlighting

# Local Operator UI

A modern, futuristic user interface for the [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) project. This UI allows you to chat with the AI assistant and track planned, executing, and completed actions.

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators
- **Planning & Execution View**: Tabbed interface to see planned, executing, and completed actions in real-time
- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

- [highlight.js](https://highlightjs.org/) - Code syntax highlighting

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators

git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

- [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) - The backend for this UI
- [Font Awesome](https://fontawesome.com/) - Icons used in the UI
- [highlight.js](https://highlightjs.org/) - Code syntax highlighting
# Local Operator UI

A modern, futuristic user interface for the [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) project. This UI allows you to chat with the AI assistant and track planned, executing, and completed actions.

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators
- **Planning & Execution View**: Tabbed interface to see planned, executing, and completed actions in real-time
- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows

```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality

- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

# Local Operator UI

A modern, futuristic user interface for the [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) project. This UI allows you to chat with the AI assistant and track planned, executing, and completed actions.

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators
- **Planning & Execution View**: Tabbed interface to see planned, executing, and completed actions in real-time
- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators
- **Planning & Execution View**: Tabbed interface to see planned, executing, and completed actions in real-time
- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

This project is licensed under the GPL 3.0 License - see the LICENSE file for details.

## Acknowledgements

- [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) - The backend for this UI
- [Font Awesome](https://fontawesome.com/) - Icons used in the UI
- [highlight.js](https://highlightjs.org/) - Code syntax highlighting
# Local Operator UI

A modern, futuristic user interface for the [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) project. This UI allows you to chat with the AI assistant and track planned, executing, and completed actions.

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators
- **Planning & Execution View**: Tabbed interface to see planned, executing, and completed actions in real-time
- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

# On Windows

```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

- [Font Awesome](https://fontawesome.com/) - Icons used in the UI
- [highlight.js](https://highlightjs.org/) - Code syntax highlighting

# Local Operator UI

A modern, futuristic user interface for the [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) project. This UI allows you to chat with the AI assistant and track planned, executing, and completed actions.

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators
- **Planning & Execution View**: Tabbed interface to see planned, executing, and completed actions in real-time
- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects

# Local Operator UI

A modern, futuristic user interface for the [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) project. This UI allows you to chat with the AI assistant and track planned, executing, and completed actions.

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators
- **Planning & Execution View**: Tabbed interface to see planned, executing, and completed actions in real-time
- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

- [highlight.js](https://highlightjs.org/) - Code syntax highlighting

# Local Operator UI

A modern, futuristic user interface for the [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) project. This UI allows you to chat with the AI assistant and track planned, executing, and completed actions.

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators
- **Planning & Execution View**: Tabbed interface to see planned, executing, and completed actions in real-time
- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

- [highlight.js](https://highlightjs.org/) - Code syntax highlighting

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators

git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

- [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) - The backend for this UI
- [Font Awesome](https://fontawesome.com/) - Icons used in the UI
- [highlight.js](https://highlightjs.org/) - Code syntax highlighting
# Local Operator UI

A modern, futuristic user interface for the [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) project. This UI allows you to chat with the AI assistant and track planned, executing, and completed actions.

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators
- **Planning & Execution View**: Tabbed interface to see planned, executing, and completed actions in real-time
- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows

```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality

- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

# Local Operator UI

A modern, futuristic user interface for the [Local Operator](https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator) project. This UI allows you to chat with the AI assistant and track planned, executing, and completed actions.

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators
- **Planning & Execution View**: Tabbed interface to see planned, executing, and completed actions in real-time
- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
- **Code Block Support**: Syntax highlighting and copy functionality for code blocks
- **Dark Theme**: Sleek dark theme with neon green accents
- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices
- **API Integration**: Connects to the Local Operator backend API

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Local Operator backend running at http://localhost:8080
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### Installation

1. Clone this repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/local-operator-ui.git
cd local-operator-ui
```

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser:
```bash
# On macOS
open index.html

# On Linux
xdg-open index.html

# On Windows
start index.html
```

Alternatively, you can use a simple HTTP server:
```bash
# Using Python
python -m http.server

# Using Node.js
npx serve
```

Then open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:8000 or http://localhost:3000.

## Usage

1. **Chat with the AI**: Type your message in the input box at the bottom of the chat panel and press Enter or click the send button.

2. **View Planned Actions**: Click on the "Planned" tab to see actions that the AI has planned but not yet executed.

3. **Track Executing Actions**: Click on the "Executing" tab to see actions that are currently being executed, along with their progress.

4. **View Completed Actions**: Click on the "Completed" tab to see actions that have been completed, along with their results.

5. **Change Agent Type**: Click on the "..." next to "You are a" to select a different agent type.

6. **Use Tools**: Click on the tool icons in the footer to activate different tools.

## Customization

You can customize the UI by modifying the following files:

- `styles.css`: Change colors, sizes, and other visual aspects
- `script.js`: Modify behavior and functionality
- `api_connector.js`: Update API endpoints and communication logic

## API Integration

The UI is designed to connect to the Local Operator backend API. By default, it expects the API to be running at http://localhost:8080. You can change this in the `api_connector.js` file.

To enable API integration, uncomment the API connection code in `script.js` (around line 490).

## Features

- **Chat Interface**: Clean, modern chat interface with message bubbles and typing indicators
- **Planning & Execution View**: Tabbed interface to see planned, executing, and completed actions in real-time
- **Agent Type Selection**: Dropdown to select different agent types (click on "..." next to "You are a")
